entry_points.summary: Slash command: locate plugin root, detect mode, pull or atomic-swap, emit harness_updated event
Creates ~/.claude/plugins/z-harness@zeke-tools -> repo symlink for Claude Code
Creates ~/plugins/z-harness symlink and writes personal marketplace.json for Codex
Extracts tarball into Claude plugin location; future updates use atomic-swap path
Emits JSON: z_harness_version (git SHA), z_harness_dirty, z_harness_branch, z_harness_tag
Builds dist/z-harness-<version>.tar.gz; excludes plans/archive/exports/providers.json; runs audit

invariants: No autoupdate — all updates are explicitly user-triggered via /z-update or z-update skill.
Symlink mode aborts if git status --porcelain is non-empty; user must resolve before updating.
Symlink mode uses git pull --ff-only; diverged branches are rejected without force-merge or reset.
Tarball mode uses atomic swap: old dir moved aside before new dir moves in; restored on failure.
A harness_updated event with old_version and new_version is emitted to metrics.jsonl on every successful update.
bundle-plugin.sh deletes the output tarball and exits non-zero if audit-tarball.sh fails.
version.sh emits non-git sentinel values (non-git/unknown) rather than erroring when plugin dir has no git history.
gotchas: Tarball release URL is a placeholder in commands/z-update.md; Z_HARNESS_RELEASE_URL must be set for tarball updates to work.
Codex caches plugin skills; after symlink update /z-update reruns codex plugin add z-harness@personal, but a new thread is still required.
Symlink-mode detection checks -L (symlink) OR git rev-parse success; a tarball with .git/ inside would be misclassified as symlink mode.
bundle-plugin.sh excludes legacy plan dirs by scanning z-harness/<slug>/ for PLAN.md/SPEC.md/TASKS.md at bundle time — new plan dirs are auto-excluded.
--force in install.sh removes a non-symlink existing install (rm -rf); it does not affect symlink installs, which are always replaced.
